CalibrationSettingService

class CalibrationSettingService(dao=None, calibration_service=None)[source]

Bases: object

Read and save the calibration settings.

Parameters:
daoCalibrationSettingIniDAO | None, optional

DAO used to save the settings record. Default is None, which creates a new CalibrationSettingIniDAO.

calibration_serviceCalibrationService | None, optional

Calibration service to reuse. Default is None, which creates one on first use (see calibration_service).

Attributes:
settingsQSettings

INI file at PathConfig.calibration_setting(), read by the getters.

daoCalibrationSettingIniDAO

DAO used to save the settings record.

Notes

Each getter reads its key from settings on every call, so changes saved by the DAO are seen immediately. Values are read as text, stripped and converted; a value that cannot be converted raises ValueError.

The is_* getters return the int value of the setting (0 or 1 in practice), not a bool.

get_mediapipe_execution_mode()[source]

Return the MediaPipe running mode.

Returns:
vision.RunningMode

Always vision.RunningMode.VIDEO at present.

Notes

The code looks up "vision.RunningMode.<value>" (value of mediapipe/mediapipe_execution_mode, default "VIDEO") as an attribute of cv2. No such attribute exists, so the fallback vision.RunningMode.VIDEO is always returned and the setting has no effect.

get_opencv_capture_backend()[source]

Return the OpenCV capture backend for the current platform.

Returns:
int

The cv2 constant named by the setting (e.g. "CAP_DSHOW"), or cv2.CAP_ANY if the name is missing or unknown.

Notes

The key depends on the platform: opencv/opencv_windows_capture on Windows, opencv/opencv_mac_capture on macOS, opencv/opencv_embedded_capture on a Raspberry Pi and opencv/opencv_linux_capture on other systems.
